DECLARE txn_cur CURSOR FOR
    SELECT t.merchant_id, SUM(t.amount)
      FROM card_transactions t, merchants m
     WHERE t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
       AND t.txn_date = TO_DATE(:run_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
       AND m.status = 'A'
     GROUP BY t.merchant_id
